verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents multiple automated workflows that end with opening a pull request, e.g. fixing failed workflows and remediating security alerts, driven by GitHub/Slack/schedule triggers, indicating agents can be configured to auto-open PRs on task completion. missing for 10: explicit generic 'open PR on task completion' configuration docs/example independent of the specific bug-fix/security use cases, and hands-on/independent confirmation of this behavior.
